input.summary:
Bathroom (x5..8, y19..22, z18..21) furnished in parts/room-13.mjs: a two-cauldron water bath as the focal piece facing the north door, a water basin on the west wall, a barrel and flower pot by the window, a spruce slab shelf on the east wall, and a red rug.
Two lanterns hang from the loft floor at y23 over the rug and the bath. The lane x7 z18..20 stays clear from the door to the bath.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the part placed 11 blocks with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. `mcd room --only Bathroom` says OK: 16/16 floor cells reachable, light min 9, mean 10.9, 0 dark.
left: Plan.md has no Bathroom checklist or elements.md row to tick, so none were ticked; the Bathroom is part of the Lighting element (#24) only in spirit.

The bath is two water_cauldron blocks (level 3) and the basin one at level 1; the render from above is too small to judge the bath's read at a glance. A closer look is worth doing in the full-site render.
The quartz floor I saw in the render is the shell's floor at y18; I did not change or verify its block id and did not confirm it is smooth_quartz as plan.md's Bathroom note asks.
The shelf is a bottom spruce_slab at x8 z19..20 with no items on it; a flower pot or candle on it would need a top slab or a block under it, so the shelf reads as a bench for now.

waste.what: Looked up the layers() legend format by reading build-library source, because the kit's helper list does not say whether a legend entry can carry a block state.
waste.cost: one grep and one file read (about 2 tool calls)
waste.tool: A note in the build-library outline: layers() legend entries are either a block id or [block, stateObject]; B.* helpers already return that pair.

waste.what: Chose the lantern and furniture cells by hand, then ran make.sh and mcd room to learn the light and walk numbers instead of asking the tool for spots first.
waste.cost: one make.sh run and one room check; no retries needed
waste.tool: mcd room --suggest (or the room check run on the empty room) listing lantern spots before furnishing, so the layout can be planned against them.

companions.task: Check the bath's water source and the cauldron levels (level 3 bath, level 1 basin) so the water reads as plumbed in, not drawn in.
Confirm the bathroom floor block (the shell's y18 floor) is smooth_quartz as the plan says, and lay the shower-room floor pattern if one is wanted.
